Subject: Request: evaluation alignment workshop — Q4 calibrations

Hi Kim,

Thanks for taking this on. People Ops has reviewed the preliminary distributions for Q4 and there are a few teams where cross-functional variance is larger than our usual threshold (notably Platform Eng and Product Data). We'd like to run a short consensus workshop to: 1) surface notable outliers, 2) align on scoring rationale for ambiguous cases, and 3) capture defensible calibration notes for the audit.

Can you pull together the evaluation committee (direct managers + one peer reviewer) and propose two 60-minute slots next week? Attaching a high-level variance extract for context.

Attachments: q4-eval-variance.xlsx (spreadsheet; small)

Appreciate it — Sarah
People Ops (on behalf of Talent & Rewards)

All — confirming Tue Nov 2 at 09:00 PT. I reviewed the sheet and left inline comments in the doc link Kim shared. A couple of asks before the meeting:

1) Please bring the top two sentence rationale for each contested case (why the manager landed where they did). This keeps discussion focused and evidence-based.
2) If a case ties to a recent org change (reorg or role scope shift), flag it so we can decide whether to adjust anchor expectations vs. the score itself.
3) Capture a single post-calibration note per person (short) that People Ops can archive for audit.

I also recommend we decide on two fallback actions for borderline cases: small stretch plan vs. adjusted comp eligibility — so managers leave with clear next steps.

Laura
VP, Product

Subject: Re: Request: evaluation alignment workshop — Q4 calibrations — summary and actions

Team — thanks for the focused session this morning. Summary below (final notes attached).

Key outcomes:
- Reviewed 8 contested cases (5 Platform Eng, 2 Product Data, 1 Site Reliability). We reached consensus on 7/8; one remains pending additional manager evidence (see action 2).
- Adjusted anchors: two managers' medians were normalized downward by one decile to reflect peer medians; these adjustments are documented in the attached consensus-actions doc.
- Post-calibration notes: short, auditable rationale created for each discussed employee and uploaded to People Ops folder.

Actions (owners and timelines):
1) Markus — provide the two pending manager writeups and any supporting PR/metric snippets by EOD Nov 4. (Attachment: sample-case-briefs.pdf)
2) Laura + Vivek — review the pending case after Markus' writeups and decide on final score by Nov 6.
3) Neha — consolidate final post-calibration notes and send to Sarah for archival by Nov 8.
4) Kimberly — circulate finalized comp eligibility guidance to managers after archive confirmation (Nov 9).

Attachments: consensus-actions-20261102.docx, eval-committee-notes.pdf

If anything above looks off, flag it now. Otherwise I'll mark this thread closed once Neha confirms upload.

—Kim

Redwood Inference
